name: s-bike-hub
description: Coach from your smart-bike training hub: check-ins, plans, rides, lifting, workouts and training load for bike, run and swim.
long_description: Connects an optional AI assistant to the locally running training hub: macro program preview/apply, three starter workload forecasts, sport planning, check-ins, import, lifting and progress evidence. The Hub stores records locally. Training context returned to an external AI is subject to that service’s policies.
